pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-bar-chart against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-bar-chart id="c" label="Продажи по городам, 2026" x="city" y="q1,q2" y-format="integer"></sf-bar-chart>
<sf-bar-chart id="s" label="Заказы по каналам" x="month" y="web,shop,partners" stack="normalized"></sf-bar-chart>
<sf-bar-chart id="h" label="Рейтинг" x="city" y="q1" orientation="horizontal" sort="descending"></sf-bar-chart>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by a summary; a gap draws no bar
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.summary

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"q1": "I квартал", "q2": "II квартал"}; c.items = [{"city": "Москва", "q1": 420, "q2": 465}, {"city": "Санкт-Петербург", "q1": 310, "q2": 298}, {"city": "Казань", "q1": 180, "q2": 214}, {"city": "Новосибирск", "q1": 150, "q2": 171}, {"city": "Екатеринбург", "q1": 164, "q2": 159}, {"city": "Нижний Новгород", "q1": 120, "q2": null}]; const s = document.querySelector('#s'); s.names = {"web": "Сайт", "shop": "Магазин", "partners": "Партнёры"}; s.items = [{"month": "2026-07", "web": 42, "shop": 30, "partners": 12}, {"month": "2026-08", "web": 45, "shop": 28, "partners": 15}, {"month": "2026-09", "web": 51, "shop": 26, "partners": 14}, {"month": "2026-10", "web": 55, "shop": 25, "partners": 18}, {"month": "2026-11", "web": 58, "shop": 24, "partners": 20}, {"month": "2026-12", "web": 66, "shop": 29, "partners": 22}]; const h = document.querySelector('#h'); h.items = [{"city": "Москва", "q1": 420, "q2": 465}, {"city": "Санкт-Петербург", "q1": 310, "q2": 298}, {"city": "Казань", "q1": 180, "q2": 214}, {"city": "Новосибирск", "q1": 150, "q2": 171}, {"city": "Екатеринбург", "q1": 164, "q2": 159}, {"city": "Нижний Новгород", "q1": 120, "q2": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const s = document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(s.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Продажи по городам, 2026' && s.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'диаграмма' && /Категорий: 6\./u.test(d.textContent) && /I квартал: наибольшее 420 \(Москва\)/u.test(d.textContent) && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-bar-chart-bar').length === 11; })()

checks.title: the arrows walk the bars and the series, each move is said; Enter chooses the bar
checks.covers: keyboard.host (ArrowRight, ArrowDown, End, Enter, Escape), events.select

steps.check: (() => { const bars = [...document.querySelectorAll('#s .sf-bar-chart-series')].map((g) => g.querySelector('.sf-bar-chart-bar')); const total = bars.reduce((sum, bar) => sum + Number(bar.getAttribute('height')), 0); const plot = document.querySelector('#s .sf-bar-chart-baseline'); return Math.abs(total - (Number(plot.getAttribute('y1')) - Number(bars[2].getAttribute('y')))) <= 2 && /^июль 2026 г\.?, Сайт: 50 ?% \(42\)$/u.test(document.querySelector('#s [aria-live]').textContent.trim().replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' ')); })()

steps.check: (() => { const bars = [...document.querySelectorAll('#h .sf-bar-chart-bar')]; const ys = bars.map((bar) => Number(bar.getAttribute('y'))); const ws = bars.map((bar) => Number(bar.getAttribute('width'))); return bars.length === 6 && ys.every((y, i) => i === 0 || y > ys[i - 1]) && ws.every((w, i) => i === 0 || w <= ws[i - 1]); })()
